setupIntro: Notes and images are saved on this computer and synced to a private notebook in your own GitHub account. Cloud data is private by default and is not stored on the plugin author's servers.
setupConnectedHint: Opening the notebook checks for updates. Edits are saved locally while offline.
setupInitializing: Waiting for the first sync. The library opens when it completes.
setupAccount: Sign in and choose a cloud notebook
setupLoginWaiting: Finish verification on GitHub. One-time code
setupParentHint: Choose a parent folder. A subfolder with the same name as your cloud notebook will be created. Cancel keeps the previous location.
setupFolderOccupied: This folder already contains files and cannot be used for first-time setup. Existing files have not been changed.
setupOccupiedCreate: Change the new cloud notebook name in step 2, or choose a different parent folder.

setupPickerFailed: Could not open the folder chooser. Try again. Your previous location has not changed.
setupPickerUnavailable: The system folder chooser is unavailable here. Choose a location in local DSH Desktop or use the default location.
setupPath: Full folder path (leave blank for suggested location)
setupOfflineHint: Internet access is needed for first-time setup. Afterwards, you can edit and save offline; sync resumes automatically when the connection returns.
setupToolsHint: The plugin uses these tools automatically. You do not need to learn or enter commands.
setupGhHint: Signs in to GitHub and authorizes access to your notebook.
setupInstallHint: Install any missing tools, then click Check again. If they still appear missing, fully quit and reopen DSH.
setupInstallHelp: How do I install these tools?
setupInstallSteps:
Use the installation link next to a missing tool to open its official website.
Windows: download the installer for your computer and use its default options.
macOS: follow the official installation guide; this plugin has not been tested on a Mac yet.
Return here and check again. You do not need to configure a Git repository or enter sync commands.
setupLoginNeedsTool: Install GitHub CLI and check again to sign in here.
setupCloudHint: GitHub stores your cloud copy. A repository is a space for your notes and images. This plugin only connects dedicated private repositories in your own account.
setupCreateHint: Recommended for first-time use. Keep the suggested name below and the plugin will create a private repository for you.
setupExistingHint: Choose this on another computer or to restore notes. Enter the name of a notebook previously created by Fatfish Notes in the same account.
setupLocalHint: This computer also keeps a copy of your notes and images. Use the default location or choose another parent folder. First-time setup requires a new or empty folder.
setupPrerequisites: Install the tools and sign in to GitHub to check and continue.
setupFirstSyncHint: Tool installation and sign-in have been checked. The first sync starts after confirmation. You can use the notebook once it succeeds.
setupNetwork: Unable to connect to GitHub. Check whether this computer can open github.com, then retry once the connection is restored.
setupSyncFailed: Sync did not complete. Check your connection and GitHub authorization, then retry. Existing local content is preserved.
